profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Fixify
profile.geoLocationName: Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, United States
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience building web applications.

My background is strongest in frontend engineering, with deep experience in React, TypeScript, GraphQL, component architecture, and design systems. Over time, I’ve expanded into full-stack development with Ruby on Rails and Node.js, as well as mobile development with React Native and Expo.

At Monograph, I worked in an early-stage startup environment where I helped establish frontend infrastructure, contributed to the design system and TypeScript adoption, owned product features end-to-end.

I enjoy working on products where I can combine technical execution with product thinking — whether that means designing a frontend architecture, collaborating on UX, writing backend logic, or leading a project from planning through release.

I’m especially drawn to startup and growth-stage environments where engineers have meaningful ownership and can work closely across disciplines.

Outside of work, I enjoy cooking and writing fanfiction:))
